episodes.title: Cults Part 2! (feat. Cody Lee Walker)
episodes.description:
We're back for PART 2 of our wonderful episode on Cults with our very special guest, Cody Lee Walker!

We cover Jessica's story in this episode! Listen in as we talk about sexy pirates, the filmography of Taika Waititi, and like...feelings in general...

The story in this episode is:
Blood under the Skin by CartoonMayor

If you're in Chicago, you should go see Murder at Moidah Mannor at the Annoyance! It's playing on Thursdays from October 8th to November 5th!
